recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: Lime-marinated chicken with cumin and smoked paprika over cilantro-lime rice; black beans, corn, pico, melty Mexican cheese, Greek yogurt to finish.

yield.perServingContainerNote: Main + cheese sprinkle. Pico and Greek yogurt in separate small jars.

ingredients.name: Spice rub (cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, oregano, salt)
Pico de gallo (tomato + onion + jalapeño + lime + cilantro)
Mexican blend shredded cheese
ingredients.substitutionNote: Cotija was wanted; Mexican blend substituted (Cotija ship-only at Walmart pickup)

equipment: Air fryer (for chicken — 400°F gives the char/Maillard the recipe wants)
assembleAndStore: 7 × 16 oz containers, each: ~1 cup cooked rice + 1 cup chicken slices (~160g cooked) + ½ cup mixed corn-pepper-bean veg + 1 oz cheese sprinkled hot to melt
Pico (~60g per serving) stays in a separate small jar — add at meal time so it stays fresh
Greek yogurt (1 Tbsp per serving) also separate — dollop at reheat

extraSteps: Top with pico (~2 Tbsp from the jar)
Sprinkle pinch of cilantro from the master cilantro bowl

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Fajitas
recipes.description: Fajita-spiced shrimp roasted with bell peppers and onions, over cilantro-lime jasmine rice with a corn tortilla on the side. High-protein, lean-fat — the shrimp does the work without dragging fat in.

yield.perServingContainerNote: Main + tortilla tucked alongside. Greek yogurt in separate small jar.

timing.keeps: shrimp best by day 4 (smell test); rice + veg keep all week

ingredients.name: Fajita spice mix (chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt)
Olive oil
ingredients.inMise: Bowl 5 + Bowl 8 (split: 1.5 Tbsp peppers, 1 Tbsp shrimp)

equipment: Half-sheet pan (large enough for shrimp + peppers in single layer)
Rice cooker OR large stovetop pot for jasmine rice
Microplane (for any garlic — recipe has garlic powder in spice mix, so optional)
Small jar for the corn tortillas (kept dry, room temp)
assembleAndStore: 7 × 12 oz containers, each: ~118g cilantro-lime rice + ~180g cooked shrimp + ~140g pepper/onion sauté + 1 corn tortilla tucked alongside
Greek yogurt stays in its own small jar; dollop at reheat
Refrigerate. Shrimp is best by day 4; visual + smell-check on day 5+.

extraSteps: Tuck tortilla on top last 15 sec to steam
Drizzle fresh ¼ lime if available

recipes.name: Black Bean Enchilada Skillet
recipes.description: A one-skillet version of black bean enchiladas — beans, peppers, jalapeño, enchilada sauce, torn corn tortillas folded in, finished with melty cheese. Topped with a fresh-fried jammy egg at reheat for the protein boost.

source.author: Cookie + Kate (adapted to skillet format with eggs)

yield.perServingContainerNote: Skillet base portioned hot. Cheese, eggs, avocado, Greek yogurt added at reheat.

timing.keeps: skillet base all week (smell test); fry eggs fresh daily

ingredients.name: Black beans, canned (drained)
ingredients.inMise: Standalone — drained, in colander (combined with Chicken Burrito Bowl prep)

ingredients.name: Spice rub (cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, salt)
Corn tortillas, small/street size
ingredients.inMise: Standalone — stacked, torn at cook time

ingredients.name: Mexican blend shredded cheese
ingredients.inMise: Standalone — straight from bag (combined with Chicken Burrito Bowl's 7 oz = 14 oz total)
ingredients.substitutionNote: Cotija was wanted; Mexican blend substituted (Cotija ship-only at Walmart pickup)

ingredients.name: Avocado
ingredients.batchQuantity: 2 (~½ avocado per serving = ~30g flesh per serving)

equipment: 12-inch deep skillet or Dutch oven (one-pan dish)
Small nonstick pan (for daily egg fry at reheat)
assembleAndStore: Sauté veg → add beans + corn → add enchilada sauce → fold in torn tortillas → finish with cheese
Reserve ~55g cheese in a small jar for daily reheat top
Greek yogurt in separate small jar

reheat.method: Microwave skillet portion + separate egg fry
reheat.additionalTimeNote: fry 1 egg fresh (2-3 min, jammy yolk)
extraSteps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in small nonstick pan, medium
Crack 1 egg, cook 2-3 min for jammy yolk
Slide jammy egg on top of microwaved portion
Slice ¼ avocado (~30g flesh), fan over
Cilantro + Greek yogurt dollop + ¼ lime

recipes.name: Mexican Chocolate Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Chia + unsweetened almond milk + cocoa + cinnamon + a tiny pinch of cayenne for warmth + maple syrup, finished with toasted pepitas. Sets overnight in jars — zero Sunday cook time. The Mexican chocolate flavor profile comes from the cinnamon-cayenne combo, not from any specific bar.

yield.perServingContainerNote: Pepitas sprinkled at serve, not pre-mixed.

equipment: Medium mixing bowl + whisk (for combining the chia base)
7 × 6 oz jars or small lidded containers (for portioning)
Dry skillet for toasting pepitas (1 min, medium heat, shake constantly)
assembleAndStore: Toast pepitas in dry skillet 1-2 min, cool, transfer to small jar
Whisk Bowl 1 chia base hard for ~30 sec
Let sit 5 min, whisk again (chia clumps on first hydration; second whisk breaks it up)
Divide into 7 × 6 oz jars (~150-160g per jar)

phases.label: Phase 0 — Long-running task kickoff
phases.purpose: Kick off the longest hands-off operations so they run while you mise

task: White rice for Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps.description: Rinse 2¼ cups dry long-grain white rice (~430g) until water runs clear. Transfer to rice cooker, add water per cooker's white-rice line + ½ tsp salt. Start.

task: Jasmine rice for Sheet-Pan Shrimp Fajitas
steps.description: Rinse 1¾ cups dry jasmine (~325g) until clear. Add to a medium saucepan with 2¼ cups water + ½ tsp salt. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to lowest heat. Simmer 18 min, rest 5 min off heat.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Master mise sweep
phases.purpose: All chopping/measuring/bagging for all 4 recipes in one focused pass. Ordered least-to-most odoriferous.
phases.smellHierarchyNote: Phase 1 bowl ordering is least-to-most odoriferous. Since meals are eaten Monday+, sauces/dressings/pickles get free overnight fridge rest — no need to disrupt order for flavor meld.

bowls.name: Chia base
bowls.instruction: Whisk hard, rest 5 min, whisk again, portion into 7 × 6 oz jars, refrigerate. Sets fully by Monday morning — first dessert serving available Monday lunch / dinner.

bowls.name: Toasted pepitas garnish
bowls.instruction: Toast in dry skillet 1-2 min, medium heat, shaking constantly. Cool, transfer to small jar.

bowls.name: Pico de gallo
bowls.instruction: Combine in a bowl, toss, refrigerate. Flavors will meld overnight before Monday's first meal.
notes: Has allium (red onion + jalapeño); ordered after non-allium bowls.

bowls.name: Enchilada veg + spice rub
bowls.instruction: Combine in a medium bowl; the spice rub stays on top until cook.

bowls.name: Fajita peppers + onions

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.qty: 1.5 Tbsp (will drizzle on sheet pan at cook time)

bowls.instruction: Combine peppers and onion in a medium bowl. Olive oil and salt drizzle at cook time on the sheet pan.

bowls.name: Burrito-bowl veg sauté
bowls.instruction: Combine in a medium bowl; ready to sauté.

bowls.name: Master cilantro garnish
bowls.instruction: Single bowl; portion across recipes during assembly.

bowls.name: Shrimp + fajita spice

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.qty: 1 Tbsp (will drizzle on sheet pan with shrimp)

bowls.instruction: Toss shrimp with all in a large bowl; let sit during Phase 2 prep (10-15 min light marinade).

bowls.name: Chicken marinade

ingredients.name: Chicken breast, raw
ingredients.qty: ~1,490g (~3.3 lb), trimmed and pounded slightly to even thickness

bowls.instruction: Toss in a large bowl or gallon zip bag; refrigerate. Should be marinating from Saturday night per the schedule. If you didn't pre-marinate, give the chicken at least 30 min before air-frying — though 4 hr is much better.
notes: Chicken should already be marinating from Saturday night per the schedule.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Cook with partial parallelism
phases.purpose: Hands-off operations run concurrently; active work happens one step at a time.

task: Heat 2 tsp oil in 12" skillet, medium-high
Stir in 3 cans drained black beans + 1 cup frozen corn (~175g)
Spread Bowl 5 (peppers + onions, ~980g) on sheet pan
Sprinkle ~140g cheese (reserve 55g for daily reheat) across surface
Portion ~480g per container into 7 × 16 oz containers
Cool while you cook the rest
Pull chicken from marinade (Bowl 9), shake off excess
Load air fryer (~½ lb per batch)
Peppers crisp-tender from oven (12 min in)
Clear center; tip Bowl 8 (shrimp + spice rub) onto cleared space
Return to oven 5-7 min for shrimp
Shrimp pink and curled into a "C" — pull sheet pan from oven
Squeeze ½ lime over the pan
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in skillet, medium-high
Tip Bowl 6 (corn + red pepper, ~440g) into pan
Season with a pinch of cumin + salt
Drain 3 cans of black beans, rinse
Warm in saucepan with cumin + salt (60s in microwave works)

miseReferences.label: 3 cans black beans for Chicken Burrito Bowl

task: Toss cooked white rice with chopped cilantro + 1 lime's worth of juice
Portion into 7 × 12 oz containers: ~118g jasmine rice (cilantro-lime tossed) + ~140g pepper/onion sauté + ~180g cooked shrimp
Greek yogurt to a separate small jar
Slice both batches (~160g cooked chicken per serving)
Portion into 7 × 16 oz containers: ~158g cooked rice + ~160g sliced chicken + ½ cup burrito-bowl veg + black beans (~½ cup) + 1 oz cheese sprinkled hot
Pico (~60g) and Greek yogurt (1 Tbsp) to separate small jars per serving
Wash skillet and air fryer basket
First meals available Monday lunch — all sauces/pico/cheese melded by then
